name: American Legion Auxiliary Texas Bluebonnet Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Texas
what_you_do: Spend a week at Texas Lutheran University in a pretend 51st state. You set up your own city, county and state governments and take a trip to the State Capitol.
grades: Junior year (11th grade) of high school
who_can_apply: Female students now in their junior year at any Texas public or private high school. An ALA Unit may sponsor a home school student who meets the rules. You can attend only once. A student whose religion does not allow her to pledge allegiance to the U.S. flag is not eligible. You must be able to take part in all activities.
pay_detail: The 2026 fee was $550 per delegate, not including travel to Seguin. Rules say a unit, school or community group pays it, never the student or her family.
duration: One week. The 2026 session was Sunday June 14 to Saturday June 20, 2026.
deadline_text: 2027 dates are not posted. In 2026, units could reserve spots Feb 1 to May 1 and schools Feb 15 to May 1. The page says spots fill fast, so act quickly.
how_to_apply: You do not apply on your own. A school nominates you through faculty and a school official, and a local ALA Unit, the school or a community group reserves the spot. Ask your counselor or a local American Legion Auxiliary Unit early in the spring. Questions: GirlsState@alatexas.org or 214-733-7945.
notes: Girls State is for girls. Texas Boys State is a separate program run by the American Legion. Students chosen must attend the whole session to earn the certificate and pin.
